title: CheckEval: A reliable LLM-as-a-Judge framework for evaluating text generation using checklists

live_model.evidence: "(4) GPT models: GPT-4-Turbo, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini"; "we set temperature = 0, n = 1, and fix the random seed for both G-Eval, SEEval and CheckEval" (Sec. 4.3-4.4)

prompt.location: Appendix F: Figures 5-6 (evaluation prompt), 7-8 (augmentation), 9 (filtering); checklist questions themselves are examples only
prompt.note: Checklists generated with GPT-4o + human filtering, released in github.com/yukyunglee/CheckEval

claim.metric: sample-level Spearman rho with human scores, SummEval average over 4 dimensions (CheckEval)
claim.location: Table 1, row GPT-4 Turbo / CheckEval, column SummEval rho

data.source: SummEval (1,600 summaries with human ratings); Topical-Chat

notes: Version not printed; resolved by date rule (EMNLP 2025). Paper reports ~$66 per full SummEval run with GPT-4 Turbo.

resolution.plan: The evaluation prompt (Figures 5-6) is printed but the per-dimension checklists (GPT-4o-generated, human-filtered) that fill it are only in the repository. Take the SummEval checklists from the repo, run GPT-4 Turbo at temperature 0, n = 1, fixed seed over the 1,600 SummEval summaries for the four dimensions, aggregate the Boolean answers into scores, and compute sample-level Spearman with the human ratings, averaged over dimensions (0.52).
resolution.approximation: Seed is unspecified; snapshot resolved by the date rule.
